outcome: Receipt of postpartum check by a health professional in a childbirth facility
cohort: 137,218 women from 33 sub-Saharan African countries who gave birth in a health facility within 5 years prior to the survey
finding: The study revealed suboptimal levels of postpartum checks in health facilities across various sub-Saharan African countries, with significant disparities based on mode of delivery, type of facility, and healthcare provider.
mod_finding: Women who underwent cesarean section had significantly higher odds of receiving a postpartum check compared to those who had vaginal deliveries.
